1092|fc807fb6.name: Captain Rugelfuss
1092|fc807fb6.text: At ease, $R.  This is no time for formalities.  With the Alliance forces under attack, the protection of the Dwarven territories becomes even more critical.  The recent Trogg uprising poses a dreadful threat to the King's land.

1340|e3153a3c.name: Mountaineer Kadrell
1340|e3153a3c.text: Hello, $N.  Welcome to Thelsamar, and while you're here don't forget to visit our local brewery!

1572|04178a2e.name: Thorgrum Borrelson
1572|04178a2e.text: Mark my words!  You won't find faster gryphons anywhere in the Eastern Kingdoms than the ones right here in Thelsamar!

1573|10cfc531.name: Gryth Thurden
1573|10cfc531.text: The Wildhammer dwarves might have fast steeds, but can those Aerie Peak gryphons stand the heat of The Great Forge?  I think not!

2057|b0e063a7.name: Huldar
2057|b0e063a7.text:
This is a dangerous line of business!

Miran just left with a delivery. He should be back in a few minutes.

2057|f6158e52.name: Huldar
2057|f6158e52.text:
Delivering these barrels to the excavation site is hard work, but there are so many depending on us to get the blast powder there.

We must do what we can against the Dark Irons!

253092|e0247c5d.name: Alba Fairmoon
253092|e0247c5d.text:
I am told the farms of Westfall once supplied a bounty of crops for Stormwind. But now, the soil is barren and most of the farmers have fled.

On behalf of Darnassus I would like to offer my aid in replenishing this land. Will you assist me?

5595|7a20e7fe.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|7a20e7fe.text: That Jormund Stonebrow has a knack for the needle, he does.  Should you be needing some training, then you'll find him at Stonebrow's Clothier on the northern side of The Great Forge.

5595|8f560eff.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|8f560eff.text: Which profession trainer would ye be looking for?

5595|ce6a7b9d.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|ce6a7b9d.text: What do ye need directions to?

6734|b63e4e81.name: Innkeeper Hearthstove
6734|b63e4e81.text: Fill yer tankard and pull up a chair. We've stories to tell and kegs to empty.

117-accept.name: Grimbooze Thunderbrew
117-accept.text:
Hurry, my friend, move with haste 
In order for our rich lager to taste 
More like beer and less like stew, 
Hops are needed to make the brew.
117-accept.title: Thunderbrew

13-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
13-complete.text: Your worth to The People's Militia has been validated by your brave acts thus far.
13-complete.title: The People's Militia

14-accept.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
14-accept.text: Some Defias have eluded us.  My most trusted scout reports that these Defias have been looting and pillaging the countryside, all the way into Southern Westfall.  We believe they are hiding out in the Dagger Hills, plotting their next move.   Slay the wretches in the name of The People's Militia.
14-accept.title: The People's Militia

14-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
14-complete.text: When I left the tainted lands of Lordaeron I returned to a grim state of affairs here in my homeland.  But there is hope for Westfall yet.  As proven by your valor in battle, it is obvious to me that you serve our cause with honor.  It is with great pride that I induct thee into The People's Militia.  May the Light shine upon you.
14-complete.title: The People's Militia

161-accept.name: Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII
161-accept.text:
If my suspicions are correct, this is some type of explosive powder.  This must be analyzed by an explosives expert so we know just what we're dealing with here.  Ashlan Stonesmirk was assigned to the regiment guarding Dun Modr and the Thandol Span.  I need you to make a grave and perilous journey, $N.

Travel through the Algaz Gate, follow the road through the Wetlands and seek out Stonesmirk in Dun Modr.  Heed my advice: stick to the roads and stop for nothing!
161-accept.title: A Dark Threat Looms

199-accept.name: Unknown
199-accept.text: You take a sample of the strange smelling powder.
199-accept.title: A Dark Threat Looms

199-complete.name: Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII
199-complete.text: This is an alarming discovery, to say the least!
199-complete.title: A Dark Threat Looms

199-progress.name: Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII
199-progress.text: Did you happen to discover any clues, $N?
199-progress.title: A Dark Threat Looms

217-complete.name: Captain Rugelfuss
217-complete.text: Most excellent, $N!  You have brought hope to Loch Modan.  With Grawmug dead, we stand a better chance of seeing the Troggs eliminated from the land.
217-complete.title: In Defense of the King's Lands

250-accept.name: Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII
250-accept.text:
Thank the stars someone is concerned about the well-being of the Dam.  First the destruction of the Thandol Span and then the pillaging of Dun Modr!  I have no doubt that the Dam will be the target of the next Dark Iron threat.  Most of the security detail here was reassigned to the Alliance Front, including my top inspector.

That's why I need you, $N.  I spotted some Dark Iron Sappers milling about the eastern ramp of the Dam.   Investigate the area and bring back a clue.
250-accept.title: A Dark Threat Looms

250-complete.name: Unknown
250-complete.text: The suspicious looking barrel contains a strange smelling powder.
250-complete.title: A Dark Threat Looms

271-complete.name: Daryl the Youngling
271-complete.text:
Er... what's this? A bear's head, by the looks at it.

<He runs a finger along his scar unconsciously.>

Well, that's quite an interesting kill you have yourself there. Couldn't be that bear from back then...

<He trails off then starts to visibly shake.>

Oh, take that away take it away! Get that grisly thing out of here!
271-complete.title: Vyrin's Revenge

271-progress.name: Daryl the Youngling
271-progress.text:
Ah, $N! Back so soon? No doubt you've been at the hunt again? Don't worry if you've had some setbacks, in the long run it will make you better!

...You couldn't get much worse, anyway...
271-progress.title: Vyrin's Revenge

273-accept.name: Jern Hornhelm
273-accept.text:
It's not too late though, you're welcome to go look for Huldar. He can't have made it very far, strong as they are, Miran and Saean can only move so fast laden down with those barrels.

They're taking the normal route to the site, leaving south out of town and following the curve of the Loch.

Shouldn't have a problem finding them unless they've already gotten there.
273-accept.title: Resupplying the Excavation

273-complete.name: Huldar
273-complete.text:
Hmph, it'll take more than a Dark Iron ambush to stop the deliveries!

But Saean... I would never have suspected him to be one of their sympathizers. We've been working with him for almost a year now... maybe I missed the signs.

Well, I'll consider that later.
273-complete.title: Resupplying the Excavation

297-complete.name: Magmar Fellhew
297-complete.text:
You got them!  Nicely done, $N!

And you don't look too worse for wear, even with those berserk Troggs about.  I'm going to keep my eye on you...you show some promise.
297-complete.title: Gathering Idols

297-progress.name: Magmar Fellhew
297-progress.text: Do you have those Idols?  We must study them and report our findings to Ironforge!
297-progress.title: Gathering Idols

302-complete.name: Jern Hornhelm
302-complete.text:
What? Stormpike wants you to personally see the shipment to Ironband?

I... suppose that's fine, the only problem is, I've already sent Huldar with the porters, Miran and Saean. You just missed them, they left just a short while ago.
302-complete.title: Powder to Ironband

309-accept.name: Miran
309-accept.text:
Ready to go, $N?

First, we need to get this powder to Ironband. It'll be a lot for me to carry, and these parts can get dangerous -- and who knows what else the Dark Irons might have in store for me.

I'll feel a lot better with you coming along.
309-accept.title: Protecting the Shipment

309-complete.name: Prospector Ironband
309-complete.text:
Oh, thank the Light the powder is here. But it is troubling news that you bring as well. To think that the Dark Irons have sympathizers able to procure this sort of material for their dastardly plans.

That's a matter for someone else to consider, some other time. I must put this powder to good use.
309-complete.title: Protecting the Shipment

454-accept.name: Huldar
454-accept.text:
We'd been hauling the barrels of powder back and forth in trips before this... business. Now we have to split up the work, Miran's taking the barrels and I'm watching over the other ones.

I don't feel safe letting Miran haul the rest of the shipment by himself. When he's ready to go, maybe you could escort him on his next trip?
454-accept.title: After the Ambush

454-complete.name: Miran
454-complete.text:
Hello, $c.

You'll be escorting me to the excavation site? That's good to hear... After Saean and his cronies, who knows what else the Dark Irons might have up their sleeves?

Anyways, let me just make some final checks. Talk to me again when you're ready to go.
454-complete.title: After the Ambush

468-accept.name: Mountaineer Kadrell
468-accept.text:
Mountaineer Rockgar is looking for volunteers for a mission through Dun Algaz and into the Wetlands.  

If you want to get your boots wet in that soggy county to the north, then speak with Rockgar at Dun Algaz.  Dun Algaz is north up the road, beyond the guard tower.
468-accept.title: Report to Mountaineer Rockgar

531-accept.name: Daryl the Youngling
531-accept.text:
Light! Don't bring things like that into the Lodge... it's unsanitary, unspeakable, un... un... unsanitary!

Just get it out of here, will you? No one wants to see your bloody little trophy, really!
531-accept.title: Vyrin's Revenge

531-complete.name: Vyrin Swiftwind
531-complete.text: Thanks for helping me out with my little plan, $N. I've been itching for months to get back at that snooty, stuck-up boy, and I'd say we did a pretty good job! Here, have this, you've earned it.
531-complete.title: Vyrin's Revenge

531-progress.name: Vyrin Swiftwind
531-progress.text: Great job, $N! We really showed him! Here, give me the head and I'll take care of it.
531-progress.title: Vyrin's Revenge

86585-progress.name: Captain Rugelfuss
86585-progress.text: That banner looks like it's been in a war!
86585-progress.title: Banner of the Fallen
